questions.statement: Which month is the first month of the year?
questions.context: El primero de enero las familias de Cali celebran el comienzo del año nuevo.

options.feedback: Incorrect. December is the last month of the year, not the first.
Incorrect. June is the sixth month, in the middle of the year.
Incorrect. March is the third month, after January and February.
Correct. January is the first month; the new year starts on January 1st.

questions.explanation: El año empieza en enero, que en inglés es "January". El último mes es "December" (diciembre). Los meses en inglés siempre se escriben con mayúscula inicial.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: How many months are there in one year?
questions.context: En la clase de inglés en Bucaramanga, la profesora cuelga un calendario con todos los meses.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Seven is the number of days in a week, not months in a year.
Incorrect. Ten is two short; from January to December there are twelve months.
Incorrect. About thirty is the number of days in a month, not months in a year.
Correct. A year has twelve months, from January to December.

questions.explanation: Un año ("year") tiene doce meses: "twelve months". No hay que confundirlo con los siete días de la semana ni con los treinta días, más o menos, que tiene un mes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Los niños de un colegio de Ibagué completan la lista de meses en el tablero.

options.feedback: Correct. The order is March, April, May, June, so May is missing.
Incorrect. July comes after June, so it cannot go between April and June.
Incorrect. February comes before March, at the start of the list.
Incorrect. August comes after July, far after June.

questions.explanation: El orden de los meses es "January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December". Entre abril ("April") y junio ("June") está mayo, "May".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "In Colombia, many families have a Christmas tree with lights. Christmas Day is on the 25th of ___."
questions.context: En diciembre las calles de Medellín se llenan de alumbrados y las familias arman el pesebre.

options.feedback: Incorrect. November comes before December; Christmas is in December.
Correct. Christmas Day is on December 25th.
Incorrect. January is the start of a new year, after Christmas.
Incorrect. October is the month of Halloween, on October 31st, not Christmas.

questions.explanation: La Navidad ("Christmas") se celebra el 25 de diciembre, "December 25th". En Colombia diciembre es el mes de los alumbrados y las novenas. Octubre ("October") es el mes de Halloween.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Today is July 19th. Tomorrow is a holiday in Colombia: Independence Day." What is the date of Independence Day?
questions.context: En Colombia, el Día de la Independencia hay desfiles y banderas en todas las ciudades.

options.feedback: Incorrect. July 19th is today in the text; the holiday is tomorrow.
Incorrect. July 18th is the day before today, not tomorrow.
Correct. Tomorrow is the day after July 19th, so it is July 20th.
Incorrect. August 7th is another holiday in Colombia, but the text says tomorrow, July 20th.

questions.explanation: El texto dice que hoy es 19 de julio y que mañana ("tomorrow") es el Día de la Independencia. El día siguiente es el 20 de julio, "July 20th", fecha en que Colombia celebra su independencia.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read the dialogue.
Boy: "When is your birthday?"
Martina: "___"
questions.context: En una fiesta en Pasto, un niño nuevo le pregunta a Martina cuándo cumple años.

options.feedback: Correct. "When" asks for a time, and "in May" says the month of her birthday.
Incorrect. This tells her age; it answers "How old are you?", not "When".
Incorrect. "Yes, it is" answers a yes/no question, but "When" asks for a time.
Incorrect. This says what she likes, but it does not tell when her birthday is.

questions.explanation: La pregunta "When is your birthday?" (¿cuándo es tu cumpleaños?) se responde con un mes o una fecha: "It's in May". "I'm eight years old" responde a la pregunta por la edad.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Lina's birthday is in the month after March. Her brother's birthday is in the month before March." When are their birthdays?
questions.context: Lina y su hermano cumplen años en meses cercanos y lo cuentan en la clase de inglés en Cúcuta.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The months are swapped: February is before March, so it is the brother's month.
Correct. The month after March is April, and the month before March is February.
Incorrect. May and January are two months away from March, not next to it.
Incorrect. "After" and "before" March mean they are not in March.

questions.explanation: "After" significa después y "before" significa antes. El mes después de marzo es abril ("April") y el mes antes de marzo es febrero ("February"). Por eso Lina cumple en abril y su hermano en febrero.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Samuel escribe una tarjeta en inglés para invitar a sus amigos de Barranquilla a su cumpleaños.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Birthday" is one thing, so the verb must be "is", not "are".
Incorrect. With a month alone we use "in"; "on" goes with a day or a full date.
Correct. Months start with a capital letter, and we say "in" with a month.
Incorrect. The spelling is wrong; the month is written O-c-t-o-b-e-r.

questions.explanation: En inglés los meses se escriben con mayúscula ("October"), se usa "in" con el mes ("in October") y "on" con una fecha completa ("on October 5th"). Además, con "birthday" el verbo es "is" y hay que escribir bien la palabra.
questions.subject: ingles
